attemptContinuity.incrementReason: Attempt 1 mounted the approved opaque bridge pilot. Attempt 2 preserves that work, upgrades the edge-locked source to the approved 2080x958 v2 bridge, and repairs the foreground eaves sizing regression introduced by the v2 dimensions.
attemptContinuity.newRepairHypothesis: The v2 bridge dimensions must remain local to the opaque transition panorama. Reusing those dimensions for the parallax eaves stream breaks the eaves aspect-ratio contract; keeping the eaves at the approved 1672x941 canvas restores the renderer contract while retaining the bridge's 204px overlap and -19 depth.
